# Presentation / Training Artifact

Use this template when preparing a talk, training, or professional development activity.
Copy it into the hub's `growth/current/` and rename:
`presentation-YYYY-MM-DD-short-title.prompt.md`.
The generated shape is in [docs/hub/growth.md](../docs/hub/growth.md); this is the
same headings with the field notes still attached.
